meta.title: Scheduled inventory sweep: one tick under the connection lease (R3.2)

segments.label: For each due kind, in SWEEP order

messages.label: create_task(run())
messages.note: Only when the operator file has an inventory block; every interval_seconds (60 s) until cancelled

messages.label: acquire_lease(holder, 120 s)
messages.note: Insert or take over only if the lease is mine or expired, on the database clock

messages.label: true | false → lease_held
messages.note: False: another worker sweeps this connection; skip the whole tick

messages.label: next_due_at per kind
messages.note: A kind not yet due (backing off or just collected) is skipped

messages.label: acquire_lease (renew)
messages.note: False → lease_lost: stop, another worker may have taken over

messages.label: GET list ?limit=100 as Table
messages.note: Deployments, then ReplicaSets, then Pods: owners first

messages.label: Evidence (never raises)
messages.note: Failures arrive as denied or missing evidence, not exceptions

messages.label: record_collection(evidence, kind)
messages.note: One transaction: run, resources, owns edges, observations, absence, pruning

messages.label: record_health(evidence, kind)
messages.note: Worked: failures 0, due +interval. Failed: failures+1, due +min(interval·2^n, 900 s)

messages.label: swept · lease_held · lease_lost · database_unavailable
messages.note: Counted as inventory operation 'sweep'; the loop sleeps one interval and repeats

messages.label: release_lease: DELETE where holder = me
messages.note: Best effort; an unreleased lease expires after lease_seconds anyway

cards.title: Why a lease
items: Every API replica runs the loop; only the lease holder collects
The store's out-of-order rules keep even an overlapping late write safe

cards.title: Backoff is per kind
items: A denied Deployment list backs off; ReplicaSets and Pods keep their schedule
A truncated read is not a failure: it hit Vyom's own item limit

cards.title: Database down
items: Any psycopg, credential, OS or timeout error ends the tick as database_unavailable
Nothing is collected without somewhere to store it

cards.title: Not in this path
items: No browser, model or MCP: the sweep runs with all three absent
GET /api/kubernetes/pods still collects per request until R3.3
